groups.contract: Native WebSocket connection transition prepares transport before publishing connected session
groups.disposition: Both complete pinned source bodies personally read and analyzed, no counterpart equivalence assumed. Native target construction and connect/address errors carry typed causes into DisconnectReason; wasm constructor error likewise. ToConnected is sent only after stream split; frontend drop is an explicit error. poll_connecting checks disconnect channel first, receives a completed transition, replaces receiver with dummy then commands removal/insertion of connecting/connected transport and Session together. Channel failure becomes BackendClosed. Repeated polling/disconnect behavior depends on actual native observer lifecycle and first-party handlers; no active network/disconnect execution or bespoke numeric defect asserted. MTU/session lifetime and cfg-specific target/native socket protocols are actual third-party boundaries, not grounds to inject bespoke wrappers into pinned source.

groups.contract: Native collider arithmetic owns no enforced finite/ordered guarantee and has intentional empty sentinel
groups.disposition: Complete715-line pinned body personally read. ColliderAabb::INVALID deliberately min=+Inf/max=-Inf to represent empty; do not globally outlaw this native sentinel. Constructors accept raw vectors, new computes center±half-size, size subtracts, merges min/max and center delegates midpoint. grow/shrink only debug-assert final order; finite extreme operands can overflow, negative shrink/grow can invert without release rejection. ScalableCollider::scale_by multiplies before set_scale with no computed-result admission. EnlargedAabb::update mutates min/max sequentially after containment test and has no finite/margin validation. These are native kernel/API strengthening dependencies at the actual first-party receiving/admission port, not evidence that an admitted ordinary collider fails. Need exact first-party producer/mutation contract and ordinary inputs before promotion. Preserve sensor/no-mass versus collider-disabled/still-mass distinctions and native2D/3D feature routes; f64-to-f32 obvhs narrowing is a real native conversion boundary, not a durable semantic exemption. Entity mapping of CollidingEntities maps the whole set, no count arithmetic.

groups.contract: Native rigid-body definitions preserve dynamic/static/kinematic and unbounded speed applicability
groups.disposition: Complete662-line pinned body personally read. Immutable RigidBody insertion initializes physics transform through a native hook and requires velocity/mass/pre-solve state; actual init implementation is separate dependency, no transitive coverage. Linear/angular velocity, gravity and damping wrappers expose raw mutable native scalars/vectors; they do not promise first-party finite or positive numeric contracts. MaxLinearSpeed/MaxAngularSpeed deliberately default to Infinity for no cap, signed GravityScale reverses gravity, and zero mass/static semantics are documented. First-party admission must distinguish these policies rather than impose blanket finite/positive rules on native APIs. Dominancei8 admits-128 despite stated-127..127 prose; receiver interpretation is unread here and no first-party -128 use or arithmetic consequence is established. No simulation/test/compiler execution.
